triggerCases.prompt: Iterate on my PR through independent local agent review and fixes, address actionable feedback, and repeat until no actionable findings remain.
Before handing off my PR, run the independent local agent review-and-fix loop until the current revision has no actionable feedback.
Iterate on this contributor's PR through local agent review and fixes. I own its branch and fix-and-push loop.
Review this contributor's PR and give me copy-pasteable comments without changing anything.
Perform one adversarial self-review of my current PR and do not change anything.
Iterate on this contributor's PR through local agent review and fixes until it is clear.
Run repeated reviews on this open source pull request until it is clear. I am only reviewing it and do not own its branch or fixes.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate this authored PR using an independent local agent review and existing PR feedback. Apply valid feedback, commit and push approved fixes, then recap the iterations.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A bounded local review-and-fix loop that accounts for stale existing feedback and finishes from a clean exact-candidate local review without waiting for Copilot.
assertions: Every recap row records the full immutable base and exact candidate revision, and ties the independent local review to that candidate.
The workflow accepts the supplied immutable context as its evidence route and does not attempt remote lookup.
The local agent receives the source, diff, tests, and contracts without prior findings or implementation rationale before its first pass.
When no limit is specified, the workflow permits up to five completed change rounds and reserves a final review-only pass.
The workflow neither requests another Copilot review nor waits for the supplied pending Copilot request as a completion condition.
The workflow checks the prior missing-test finding against the supplied current source and tests and records it as already fixed or stale.
A clean completed local review and complete required verification permit local-loop convergence even while Copilot is pending; missing local review evidence does not.
The workflow never marks the PR ready, merges it, resolves threads, or posts replies.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on my pull request through local agent review and fixes until no actionable findings remain.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A bounded stop that requests the missing immutable pull-request snapshot after the available evidence routes fail their capability check.
assertions: The workflow stops because the supplied capability facts explicitly record that the pull-request identity and every supported evidence route are unavailable, not merely because the prompt omits a URL.
It stops and requests a complete immutable snapshot containing the repository, base revision, head revision, diff, review state, and CI status.

It stops before tool or repository discovery and does not inspect the current directory, search for alternate clients or repository metadata, enumerate unrelated local files, try unauthenticated web clients, retry network routes, request remote review, or start a fix loop.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on my current pull request through local agent review and fixes until no actionable findings remain.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A bounded attempt to resolve the canonical pull request through the exact current checkout or one authenticated interface before any rebase or review action.
assertions: The workflow does not treat the missing prompt URL as proof that pull-request identity is unavailable.
It attempts identity and snapshot resolution through only the exact current checkout or one authenticated supported pull-request read interface before any rebase, review request, or fix loop.

If those routes cannot return a complete snapshot, it stops without searching unrelated files or metadata, trying alternate clients or unauthenticated web access, requesting Copilot review, or starting a fix loop.

outputCases.prompt: Assess the supplied local review and existing comments on my PR, but do not change or publish anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A current-head review result that reports actionable feedback without editing source, committing, pushing, or changing pull-request state.
assertions: The workflow assesses the completed independent local review and existing current-head comments against the pinned source without requesting remote reviews.
The workflow reports the accepted finding instead of editing source, committing, pushing, updating the pull request, resolving threads, posting replies, marking ready, or merging.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on this authored PR with a maximum of three change rounds and report the final recap.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A final review-only pass for the third-round head that reports actionable feedback rather than making a fourth change round.
assertions: The workflow treats the recorded third-round head as the only review boundary for the final pass.
The workflow does not make a fourth change round when the final review-only pass finds actionable feedback.
The recap identifies the iteration-limit stop and names the remaining actionable feedback and next action.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on this authored PR through the available review tools, but the self-review and feedback-handling skills are unavailable.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only, source-backed fallback review that does not mutate remote review state.
assertions: The fallback captures one current PR boundary and independently checks its diff, source, tests, feedback, and CI.
The fallback applies the mandatory deletion-first review-simplicity baseline through an internal handoff and permits an explicit no-findings result even when sibling workflow skills are unavailable.
The fallback categorizes the review concern with source-backed reasoning and does not post, resolve, or otherwise mutate remote review state.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on my PR with a local agent. Address accepted feedback locally and run the relevant checks, but do not commit or push.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Verified local fixes followed by an independent review of the updated uncommitted candidate, with no commit, push, or remote review request.
assertions: The workflow applies only the accepted local fix and verifies it with the relevant checks.
The next local agent review covers the updated working-tree diff and source contents, not merely the unchanged HEAD or remote PR head.

The workflow continues local review until no actionable findings remain or the round limit or verification gap stops it, and reports the unpublished state without committing, pushing, or requesting remote review.

outputCases.prompt: Use iterate-pr-review on this contributor's PR. I am only reviewing it and do not own its branch or fixes.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only handoff to review-pr before any iterative review or source mutation.
assertions: The workflow detects that the user neither authored the pull request nor owns its fix-and-push loop and routes the task to review-pr.
The workflow does not request remote review, start a fix loop, edit source, commit, push, update the pull request, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.

outputCases.prompt: Use iterate-pr-review on this contributor's PR and repeat local agent review and fixes until it is clear.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only handoff to review-pr because neither authorship nor fix-and-push ownership is established.
assertions: The workflow treats missing authorship and fix-and-push ownership as insufficient for iterate-pr-review and routes the task to review-pr.
The workflow does not request remote review, start a fix loop, edit source, commit, push, update the pull request, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.

outputCases.prompt: Use iterate-pr-review to fix the remaining issues on this contributor's PR, commit them, and push the branch.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An immediate read-only handoff to review-pr because requested write actions do not establish ownership of another author's fix-and-push loop.
assertions: The workflow detects the known external author and the absence of explicit fix-and-push ownership, does not treat requested edits, commits, or pushes as ownership evidence, and routes the task to review-pr.
The workflow does not request remote review, start a fix loop, edit source, commit, push, update the pull request, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on this contributor's PR. I own its branch and fix-and-push loop, but review only and do not change or publish anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An owned external iteration that reports the accepted current-head finding without treating loop ownership as edit or publication authority.
assertions: The workflow accepts explicit fix-and-push ownership for another author's pull request and assesses the completed independent local review and existing feedback.

The workflow reports the missing explicit-limit test without editing source, committing, pushing, requesting duplicate reviews, updating the pull request, resolving threads, posting replies, marking ready, or merging.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on this contributor's PR. I own its branch and fix-and-push loop. Apply accepted fixes locally, but do not commit or push.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An iterative review that passes the ownership guard, applies and executes the verified fixture fix, and preserves separate commit and push authority.
assertions: The workflow accepts explicit fix-and-push ownership for another author's pull request and runs the bounded local agent review-and-fix loop.

The workflow adds only the missing getChangeRoundLimit( 2 ) assertion to test/iteration-limit.test.mjs, runs node --test test/iteration-limit.test.mjs in the executable fixture corpus, and reports the passing result.

The workflow reviews the updated uncommitted candidate with a local agent and reports the unpublished state without committing, pushing, requesting remote review, updating the pull request, resolving threads, posting replies, marking ready, or merging.

outputCases.prompt: Continue the complete iterate-pr-review loop for my PR using a local agent until no actionable findings remain.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A fresh read-only local agent review for every changed candidate, followed by assessment, accepted fixes, verification, and another local review without remote requests.
assertions: The workflow uses a fresh read-only local subagent for each changed candidate, with the exact source and tests and no prior review conclusions or implementation rationale before its first pass.
The first local finding is checked against source, accepted, fixed, and verified; the updated candidate receives a new independent local review before convergence is declared.
The workflow does not reuse the first candidate's clean result for a changed candidate and does not finish before the final local review completes.
The workflow never calls a connector, CLI, or UI to request or re-request Copilot or another remote reviewer.
The workflow does not post comments or reviews, resolve threads, mark ready, merge, release, or change unrelated state.
The review-and-fix rounds stay local; any authorized final push follows the clean final local review and required verification.

outputCases.prompt: Continue the current iteration using the retained authority bundle.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A local review within the retained pull-request and branch boundary that rejects unrelated reviewer or metadata mutations.
assertions: The retained bundle covers only the recorded repository, pull request, task branch, and round limit; verified next local candidates within that boundary remain authorized.
The workflow continues the recorded local review without waiting for pending Copilot, requesting remote reviewers, targeting another pull request, or adding the proposed label.
The workflow requires fresh authority for changed pull-request or metadata targets.
An unexpected or stale head requires a refreshed snapshot and another review, not a new task-authority question for the same branch.
The workflow does not post comments or reviews, resolve threads, mark ready, merge, release, or change either pull request.

outputCases.prompt: Rebase this authored pull request on the latest main branch, then run the complete iterate-pr-review loop.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: One bounded authored-PR authority bundle that safely rebases, independently reviews each local candidate, publishes verified accepted fixes, and runs required authorized evaluations without repeated authority questions or remote review requests.
assertions: The workflow records the repository, pull request, task branch, OpenAI Codex evaluation destination, public tracked payload class, and five-round limit once, then does not ask separate task-authority questions for unchanged rounds.
The workflow captures and records the canonical pull-request identity and current snapshot before starting the requested rebase.

The explicit rebase verifies patch replay, the recorded remote head, required project checks, and model evaluation for the exact rebased commit before publishing the rewritten task branch with --force-with-lease; a failure prevents the push, and the workflow never uses plain --force or rewrites another branch.

For each candidate, the workflow runs an independent local agent review, assesses existing comments, applies accepted fixes, performs required verification and authorized commits, and reviews every changed candidate again. It publishes the same PR branch after local convergence and verifies the remote head.
The workflow never requests or re-requests Copilot review and does not wait for remote review evidence as a condition of local-loop convergence.

The workflow sends only the supplied version-controlled public skill content, selected public fixtures, and sanitized execution metadata to the OpenAI Codex service, and the standing consent covers exact-head reruns after in-scope revisions.

The iteration bundle does not authorize a pull-request description change; only matching standing consent may delegate the exact Evaluation-section update to write-pr-description for the recorded authored draft pull request, task branch, and head.
The workflow does not post comments or reviews, resolve threads, mark ready, merge, release, or change unrelated metadata.
The final recap names the active authority bundle and distinguishes an independent runtime approval blocker from missing user intent.

outputCases.prompt: Continue the iteration and evaluate every supplied item using the standing authorization.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A denied out-of-scope evaluation that preserves the standing public-data boundary and requires a fresh authority decision instead of transmitting private, untracked, unrelated, or differently routed data.
assertions: The workflow does not send the private review comment, untracked notes, unrelated repository content, credentials, or any payload to the new destination.
The workflow recognizes that a different repository, payload class, or destination is outside the standing authorization and requires a fresh authority decision.
The workflow does not treat the fixture, distributed skill, prior exact-head reruns, or runtime capability as user consent for the excluded payload.
The workflow does not update a pull request, post comments or reviews, resolve threads, mark ready, merge, or release while the boundary is unresolved.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on my PR using local reviews until it is clear.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A disclosed fresh-context local fallback with no Copilot request and no clean result inferred from passing checks alone.
assertions: The workflow uses self-review-pr's fresh-context fallback with the simplicity baseline because this host has no subagents.
It discloses the lack of an independent local agent and does not request or re-request Copilot or substitute a remote reviewer.
It verifies the supplied source and tests rather than treating passing CI as proof of a clean review.
